introduction.title: 👋 Introduction
introduction.description: Klint is p5.js-like React component that comes with a lot of cool plugins to make your creative development easier and (i hope), more enjoyable. It's focused on 2D graphics, using the webCanvas API. Klint fully embraces the limitations of the 2D canvas at it's core, nothing fancy, nothing outstanding, just rewrote so it makes more sense (no longer defining number with strings) just a reliable component to make 2D graphics, motion design, UX or generative art.

Klint/klint.title: 👋 Hello World
Klint/klint.description: Klint is a modern 2D canvas library designed to work seamlessly with React while providing a powerful, flexible API for creative coding. It builds upon the standard Canvas API with a more intuitive interface inspired by Processing and P5.js, but engineered for production React applications.

Klint/klint-component.title: Klint Component
Klint/klint-component.description: The Klint component is the main entry point for rendering canvas graphics in React applications.

Klint/klint-hooks.title: Klint Hooks
Klint/klint-hooks.description: Klint provides React hooks for managing state, handling input, and loading resources.

Klint/lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
Klint/lifecycle.description: Understanding Klint's lifecycle is essential for creating efficient canvas animations in React. This document explains how Klint components initialize, update, and render.

Klint/using-react.title: Using Klint with React
Klint/using-react.description: Klint is designed specifically for React, integrating with its component model while carefully avoiding unnecessary re-renders. Understanding this architecture is key to building performant canvas applications.
